# `waypoints`

Source: [`mods/waypoints`](https://github.com/aoughwl/aowlspt/blob/main/mods/waypoints).

## Settings

Defined in [`mods/waypoints/config.json`](https://github.com/aoughwl/aowlspt/blob/main/mods/waypoints/config.json). The values shown are the **shipped defaults**, not what is currently deployed.

### `patrolTuning`

- **Default:** `true`

Apply the shipped patrol-pacing tweaks to bots.types.bear/usec.difficulty.*. Only keys this database ALREADY carries are written -- the three pre-1.0 SPT names post-1.0 dropped (GO_TO_NEXT_POINT_DELTA, GO_TO_NEXT_POINT_DELTA_RESERV_WAY, USE_CHACHE_WAYS) are probed, skipped, and listed on /waypoints/status. Set false to leave BSG's pacing alone; the point data is served either way.
